Explain why the total surface area of a toy made from a cone on a hemisphere is not the sum of the total surface areas of the cone and the hemisphere.
questions.modelAnswer: Where the cone and hemisphere are joined, the circular base of the cone and the flat face of the hemisphere are glued together and hidden inside the toy. Total surface areas would count these two circles, which aren’t on the outside. The outer surface is only the curved surface of the cone plus the curved surface of the hemisphere: πrl + 2πr².
